# gyro_dns_record (Resource)

A record set (all values of one name + type) in a Gyro DNS zone. The zone must be active (see gyro_dns_zone.status).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_dns_record" "www" {
  service_id = gyro_dns_zone.example.service_id
  zone       = gyro_dns_zone.example.name
  name       = "www"
  type       = "A"
  ttl        = 300
  records    = [gyro_server.web.ipv4]
}

resource "gyro_dns_record" "mx" {
  service_id = gyro_dns_zone.example.service_id
  zone       = gyro_dns_zone.example.name
  name       = "@"
  type       = "MX"
  records    = ["10 mx1.example.com.", "20 mx2.example.com."]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Relative to the zone: "@" = apex, "www", "*.app".
- `records` (Set of String) Values in zone file syntax, e.g. ["10 mx1.example.com."] for MX. TXT quotes are optional; names without a trailing dot are relative to the zone.
- `service_id` (Number)
- `type` (String) A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, ALIAS, NS (not at the apex) or PTR.
- `zone` (String)

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) 60-86400 seconds.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<zone>/<name>/<type>   (name @ = apex)
terraform import gyro_dns_record.www 789/example.com/www/A
```
